# unreal-asm

A cross-assembler source library for ZX Spectrum assembler sources: codecs that decode and encode every source
format byte-exact, format conversion between sub-versions, dialect conversion plugins, symbols. Standard C++20 only.
Part of [unreal-ng](https://github.com/alfishe/unreal-ng); design: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/`.

## Status

- A1: the library skeleton, the encoding detectors and code page tables (CP866, KOI8-R, CP1251, ZX Spectrum, UTF-8),
  the document model, the codec registry with detection, the `text` and `sjasmplus` codecs, the `zxasm` tool.
- A2-A4: codecs of every version of the tokenized formats: `tasm` (2.0, 3, 4.0, 4.12), `alasm` (3.8 … 5.09),
  `zxasm` (2.4 … 4.20), `storm` (1.0beta, 1.2-1.3i); hobeta and TR-DOS containers.
- A5: dialect conversion through a neutral IR (`ir.h`, `dialect.h`): the `alasm` frontend, the `sjasmplus` frontend
  and backend; ALASM → sjasmplus checked against ALASM's own binaries.
- A5b: the `tasm` frontend (3 / 4.0 / 4.12); the GS 1.04 ROM sources convert and assemble to the ROM byte for byte.
  STORM and ZX-ASM frontends come next. Corpus and emulator checks: `tools/unreal-asm/` in unreal-ng.

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `include/unrealasm/` | public API: `encoding.h` (detectors, code pages, UTF-8), `document.h`, `codec.h`, `registry.h`, `containers.h`, `ir.h`, `dialect.h`, `diagnostics.h`, `unrealasm.h` |
| `src/encoding/` | code page tables (generated by `tools/scripts/gen-codepage-tables.py`), conversions, detectors |
| `src/core/` | document helpers, the registry |
| `src/codecs/<codec>/` | one folder per codec |
| `src/dialects/<dialect>/` | dialect plugins: frontends (dialect → IR) and backends (IR → dialect); `common/` holds the Z80 facts |
| `src/ir/` | IR helpers |
| `tools/zxasm/` | the `zxasm` CLI |
| `tools/symconv/` | the `symconv` CLI: symbol files from any format to any format (`symconv formats`, `symconv detect f`, `symconv f --to id`) |
| `examples/` | small programs on the public API |
| `tests/` | `unreal-asm-tests` (GoogleTest) |
| `testdata/` | the corpus the tests use, with provenance in its README |

## Build

Inside unreal-ng it is built by `core/src/CMakeLists.txt`; `unreal-asm-tests` runs in the emulator's
`test-parallel`. Standalone:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DUNREAL_ASM_TESTS=ON -DUNREAL_ASM_GOOGLETEST_DIR=<googletest sources>
ninja -C build && ./build/unreal-asm-tests
```

## Examples

```bash
zxasm formats
zxasm encoding testdata/text/source-koi8r-crlf.asm          # cp1251 / koi8-r / cp866 ranking, line ends
zxasm detect   testdata/sjasmplus/hello.asm                   # -> chosen: sjasmplus
zxasm decode   testdata/text/source-cp866-lf.asm -o out.txt   # UTF-8 text
zxasm encode   out.txt --codec text --codepage koi8-r --line-end crlf -o back.asm
unrealasmexampledetectencoding testdata/text/source-cp1251-cr.asm
unrealasmexampledecodeencode   testdata/sjasmplus/module.asm  # round trip: identical
unrealasmexampleconvertdialect 'testdata/dialects/thelink/gsports.$H'          # ALASM -> sjasmplus
zxasm convert testdata/dialects/alasm-sjasmplus/constructs.alasm.txt --codec text --from alasm --to sjasmplus
zxasm convert TheLink.trd --to sjasmplus -o out/              # every source of a disk, INCBIN files extracted
```

`unreal-asm-tests` assembles converted sources with sjasmplus and compares them with ALASM's binaries when
`UNREAL_ASM_SJASMPLUS` names the sjasmplus binary (skipped otherwise).
